records.title: Once-weekly semaglutide in adolescents with obesity: a randomized trial
records.abstract: We randomly assigned 201 adolescents (12 to 17 years) with obesity to receive semaglutide or placebo once weekly for 68 weeks. The mean change in BMI z-score from baseline was -0.45 in the semaglutide group and +0.05 in the placebo group.

records.title: Liraglutide for weight management in adolescents with obesity: a randomized, double-blind trial
records.abstract: In this double-blind trial, 251 adolescents with obesity were randomly assigned to liraglutide (3.0 mg) or matching placebo for 56 weeks. The primary endpoint was the change from baseline in the BMI standard-deviation score. Adverse events were monitored throughout.

records.title: Semaglutide in adults with obesity: a randomized placebo-controlled trial
records.abstract: We enrolled adults aged 30-55 with obesity in a double-blind, randomized trial of semaglutide versus placebo. Body weight and BMI were measured at baseline and at 68 weeks.

records.title: Patterns of antidiabetic medication use in youth with obesity: a cross-sectional survey
records.abstract: We conducted a cross-sectional survey of 480 youth with obesity attending outpatient clinics. Metformin and insulin use patterns were recorded; no trial intervention was administered, and no weight outcomes were collected.

records.title: Tirzepatide in adolescents with severe obesity: a single-arm pilot study
records.abstract: In this single-arm pilot study, 30 adolescents with severe obesity received tirzepatide, a dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist, for 24 weeks. BMI z-score and tolerability were assessed.

records.title: Real-world outcomes of weight-loss pharmacotherapy in teenagers
records.abstract: We reviewed charts of 120 teenagers prescribed weight-loss pharmacotherapy between 2019 and 2023. Weight trajectories and discontinuation reasons were recorded descriptively.

records.title: Exenatide once weekly versus placebo in adolescents with obesity and type 2 diabetes: a randomized trial
records.abstract: Adolescents aged 12-18 with obesity and type 2 diabetes were randomly assigned to exenatide once weekly or placebo for 26 weeks. Change in BMI was a prespecified secondary endpoint; the primary endpoint was glycemic control.

records.title: Gastrointestinal adverse events of GLP-1 receptor agonists: a meta-analysis in adults
records.abstract: We pooled randomized trials of GLP-1 receptor agonists in adults to estimate the risk of gastrointestinal adverse events. Weight change was not analyzed.

records.title: Semaglutide versus placebo in adolescents with Prader-Willi syndrome: a randomized trial
records.abstract: In this randomized, double-blind trial, 62 adolescents with Prader-Willi syndrome received semaglutide or placebo for 16 weeks. The primary outcome was the hyperphagia score; body composition was not assessed.

records.title: Effect of liraglutide on BMI z-score in adolescents with obesity: a randomized, placebo-controlled trial
records.abstract: We conducted a randomized, placebo-controlled trial of liraglutide in 135 adolescents with obesity. The primary outcome was the change in BMI z-score at 52 weeks; safety was assessed at each visit.

records.title: Dulaglutide in youth with type 2 diabetes: a randomized trial (conference abstract)
records.abstract: Youth aged 10-17 with type 2 diabetes were randomized to dulaglutide or placebo for 26 weeks. HbA1c and body weight were measured at each visit.

records.title: GLP-1 receptor agonists for obesity in children under 10: a retrospective cohort
records.abstract: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 88 children under 10 years treated with GLP-1 receptor agonists for obesity. BMI changes over 12 months were extracted from records.
